articles.title: US suspends military cooperation with Ecuador amid human rights violations probe
articles.author: BreakThrough News
articles.content_excerpt: The US government announced a move that has surprised many in Ecuador. For several weeks, Washington and Quito have been touting, through press releases, various military and intelligence operations against organized crime in Ecuador. According to several media outlets , including The Atlantic and The New York Times , the US has decided to suspend these joint operations until it clarifies incidents in which abuses and killings may have been committed against suspects in custody of Ecuadorian forces on September 23 . According to US media reports , Washington wants to determine whether Carlos Muñoz, alias “Charlie” – one of the leaders of Los Choneros, one of Ecuador’s most prominent criminal gangs – along with other suspects, was killed while in custody.
